_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Redbeard's Booty#000.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever ye landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Do ye remember where to go?

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: No? The crew be loiterin' at Pirate Cove. I'll be along soon, don't ye worry!

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: You are not able to move but you still hear the ongoing conversation.

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: What? Another clue! This be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#005.dst: [-{~} {~} -{~}] の海上で Marston と話す

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#006.dst: おう、よう相棒！お前さんも老 Redbeard の沈んだガレオン船を拝みに来たのか？
Redbeard's Booty#006.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#007.dst: かつては立派な船だったろう？言い伝えじゃ、史上最大の海戦の一つで沈んだそうだ！船長は波の下へ沈み、二度と姿を見せなかった！
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#008.dst: …なあ。本物の宝探しに行きてえと思ったことはねえか？お前さん、お宝を見る目がありそうだ。
Redbeard's Booty#008.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#009.dst: そいつはいい！俺は海賊の入り江で本物の宝の地図を買ったんだ、いい買い物だったぜ。あの野郎が嘘をついてなきゃ、恐るべき Redbeard の本物の財宝につながってる！
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: I ventured 'round, spied some fine jacks at the island, and I collected a crew to join me on me grand, fantastic voyage!
Redbeard's Booty#010.dst: あちこち回って、島で腕の立つ連中を見つけて、俺の壮大で素晴らしい航海の仲間を集めたのさ！
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#011.dst: もちろん、もう一人分の席はいつだってある！乗るか？人手はもっと欲しい。
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever you landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#012.dst: よし！お宝を見つけて金貨を持ち帰ろうぜ！これが手に入れた地図だ。泳ぐなり何なり、陸モンのやり方で海賊の入り江まで来い。着いたら右手の一軒目の家だ。
Redbeard's Booty#012.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#013.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の海賊の入り江で Marston の船員を見つける

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#015.dst: おやまあ坊や…あんた海賊には見えないね、あたいはただの若い娘だけどさ！
Redbeard's Booty#015.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#016.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#016.dst: そのとおりだ、兄ちゃん。洒落た鎧で俺らの家に乗り込みやがって、何者だ？
Redbeard's Booty#016.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#017.dst: ああ、Marston の連れか？そう言い張るなら、当の本人はどこだ？
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#018.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#018.dst: 後から来るって？ふうん。まあ、人手は多いほど助かるよ。あたいの船、ブラックリング号へ下りようじゃないか。
Redbeard's Booty#018.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#019.dst: じゃあ計画は聞いたんだな？戻ったら金貨風呂だぜ！ああ、俺の可愛い娘っ子も大喜びだ。
Redbeard's Booty#019.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#020.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
Redbeard's Booty#020.dst: 海賊の入り江の桟橋でブラックリング号に乗り込む。

Redbeard's Booty#022.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#022.dst: あはっ、足が速いね坊や！あたいらより先に着いたのかい！
Redbeard's Booty#022.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#023.dst: Marston の姿はまだねえか？
Redbeard's Booty#023.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#024.dst: あいつを待ってやらねえか？そもそもこの宝探しの機会をくれたのはあいつだしよ。
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#025.dst: イライラしてきたぜ…あいつ以外、船員は全員そろってるってのに！
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#026.dst: ちっ！あの仲間はどこ行ったんだい？暗くなってきた！Marston は陸に置いてくしかないね。
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#027.dst: Marston が買った地図、持ってるかい？
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#028.dst: 地図をちょいと見て、どこへ行くか決めようぜ。
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#029.dst: どうやらこの島のどれかに宝があるらしい…よし、お前が仕切れ、陸モン！島へ針路を取れ！
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#030.dst: おおい、これがお宝に違いないよ。心配いらない、Argus がすぐ出航できるよう船を見てる。
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#031.dst: よし、掘り出すぞ、野郎ども！
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#032.dst: あはっ、中で何か光ってる！こいつは金を掘り当てたね、あんたたち。
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#033.dst: Martim、陸モンをのしちまいな。
Redbeard's Booty#033.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: What? Another clue! The be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#034.dst: 何だって？また手がかり！とんだ Grook 追いの無駄骨だよ、本物のお宝はどこだい？！鍵の山で金持ちになった奴なんていないよ！！くっついてる宝石なら売れるかもね…
Redbeard's Booty#034.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#035.dst: 待て、鍵に手がかりがあるぞ！「朽ちたガレオン船に捧げよ、さすれば真の道が開かれん」
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#036.dst: ぐぬ…我慢の限界だ。Argus が来た、陸モンが起きる前に置いてこうぜ？この島は魔法で隠されてる、見つかりっこねえ。
Redbeard's Booty#036.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#037.dst: よっしゃ！この鍵で…Redbeard 本人を蘇らせられるかもしれない…あの人がまた海を恐怖に陥れて、あたいらがその船員になるんだ！
Redbeard's Booty#037.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
Redbeard's Booty#038.dst: 隠された島を離れ、海賊たちが Redbeard の財宝を盗むのを阻止する。

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Redbeard's Booty#039.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Marston と船員について話す。

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#040.dst: こんなことになるとはな…あの野郎ども、手が早えな？
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#041.dst: 陸モンにしちゃ、本当に足が速えな。俺が海賊の入り江に着いた時にゃ、お前さんはもう水平線の点だった。
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#042.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#042.dst: そういや、海の悪魔にかけて、あっちで一体何があったんだ？！
Redbeard's Booty#042.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#043.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#043.dst: ちょいと傷だらけじゃねえか！お前さんもあいつらと揉めたんだろ？
Redbeard's Booty#043.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#044.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#044.dst: よし、兄弟！あいつらを追いかけるべきだと思うぜ！俺たちゃ荒くれだが、反乱だけは許せねえ。
Redbeard's Booty#044.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#045.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#045.dst: あいつらにあの宝の資格はねえ、兄弟！お前さんに追いつけなかった以上、俺のもんでもねえ。その金はお前さんのもんだ…持ってけ！
Redbeard's Booty#045.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#046.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#046.dst: そういや…俺は一文無し同然だが、お前さんがいない間にこの魚を釣ったんだ。いい値で売れるらしい、ほらよ。
Redbeard's Booty#046.speaker: Marston
